text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити's debut is a success. After the
race, we
meet to discuss her future
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Because her fans want to see her with
the Triple
Tiara, she opts for working
toward the Tiara tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
For her next goal, we pick a race that
leads up to
that tour—the Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
